response.sql: WITH hand_tallies AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), hand_shares AS (SELECT throws, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_tallies), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(h.tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(h.share) AS average_share, AVG(h.share - a.share) AS average_above_average FROM hand_shares AS h CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE h.share > a.share;
